name: West Buttress
descent_text: Descend via a combination of rappelling and downclimbing, including a notably exposed ledge traverse, back to the col/notch; from there, downclimb the steep snowfield (self-arrest position with ice axe) back toward Aasgard Pass and out via Colchuck Lake to the trailhead.
approach: Same approach as the other routes: Stuart Lake/Colchuck Lake Trailhead to Colchuck Lake (5,570 ft), then the steep Aasgard Pass trail to the col behind Witches Tower; a steep snowfield crossing (ice axe recommended) leads to the route's base on the west side.
overview: An easy, two-pitch roped rock route up the tower's west side - mostly Class 4 solid granite with a short Class 5 chimney, finishing on a friction slab to the summit.
beta: From the col/notch behind the tower, cross a steep snowfield (ice axe recommended) to reach the base. The route climbs mostly Class 4 rock with a short Class 5 chimney partway up, on solid granite with good natural hand- and footholds, finishing with a friction-face section to the summit.
fa: Charles Sink and Eric Gerber, July 4, 1971
